description:
CallSiteMap/CallSiteTargetsMap slots are never pruned when their ledger fact
retracts. The ledger-withdrawn/store-stale state is read nowhere today
(measured 0 across corpus/lib/matrix/cli at fz-kdt.69.2) but three
artifact.rs unit tests construct exactly that state, so the invariant is
accidental, not structural. The one production divergence site is
materialize_direct_call_edge's store read (the 69.2 comment there names the
ledger-vs-store question).

STANDALONE DECISION (no longer tied to any demand-derivation route -- that
died with fz-kdt.69.3): either (a) prune the stores on fact retraction so
ledger and store cannot diverge, or (b) document the store-outlives-ledger
contract explicitly and gate the divergent read. (a) is
correct-by-construction; measure that nothing depended on stale reads
(expected: nothing does).
title: CallSiteMap/CallSiteTargetsMap slots never pruned on fact retraction
